policy: References informed taxonomy, size, appendage layout, proportions and colour placement only. No pixels were sampled, traced, copied or redistributed. Seller imagery was not used as a texture, proportion or tracing source; the borrowed gastropod shell is an authored generic turbinate form, not a specific specimen.

referenceGradeRationale: Taxonomy, size and colour placement are authoritative (WoRMS, Naturalis, original description). Openly licensed in-situ photographs give oblique and dorsal views of the animal in its shell, but no calibrated side/top/front plates exist; limb segment proportions and the borrowed shell form are inferred from general Diogenidae anatomy and are therefore grade B rather than A.
